title: Action for the second decider
statement: Given a register index $r$, a state $j_1$, a state-valued function $j_{RB}$ on Booleans, a Boolean $b_1$, and optional Boolean values $a,c$, define an action as follows. If $b_1$ is false and $a$ is true, use the action prescribed by $r$ and $j_{RB}$ evaluated at whether $c$ is absent; otherwise, if $c=b_1$, use the action prescribed by $r$ and $j_1$; in all other cases use the action prescribed by $r$ and $j_{RB}$ evaluated at false.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean input string $x$ (implicit in the action construction)
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the action constructor used for the selected actions, so their machine-level effects cannot be rendered more explicitly.
